title: APPROVAL OF ONE-YEAR CONTRACT EXTENSIONS AND ISSUANCE
text:
[VII. LEGAL/LITIGATION]
APPROVAL OF ONE-YEAR CONTRACT EXTENSIONS AND ISSUANCE
  OF REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR OUTSIDE SECURITIES
  MONITORING AND LITIGATION COUNSEL AND POSSIBLE BOARD
